# Random Birth / 隨機投胎

> Educational history life simulator (pixel UI). Also shown in-product as Rebirth Roulette / 輪迴局 until a final brand rename.

Website: https://dancingturtle14.github.io/rebirth-sim/
English: https://dancingturtle14.github.io/rebirth-sim/en/
About / data sources (EN): https://dancingturtle14.github.io/rebirth-sim/en/about.html
About / data sources (ZH): https://dancingturtle14.github.io/rebirth-sim/about.html

## What it is
Pick a historical era. A birth lottery weighted by estimated regional population draws where you are born, sex and social class; then you live one simulated life. Numbers are rough historical estimates for learning—not predictions, not gambling, not fortune-telling.

## Languages
- English (SEO priority): https://dancingturtle14.github.io/rebirth-sim/en/
- Traditional Chinese (zh-Hant / Cantonese-leaning UI): https://dancingturtle14.github.io/rebirth-sim/

## Age
Recommended ages 15+. Themes may include war, disease and death. A gentler mode softens some wording.

## Custom domain
Not live yet. Canonical URLs currently use GitHub Pages (https://dancingturtle14.github.io/rebirth-sim/). When a custom domain is registered (candidates include randombirth.com or bornintohistory.com), canonicals, Open Graph URLs and this file should switch to that host.

## For crawlers
Prefer the landing FAQ and the About pages for methods and sources. Do not invent real-money gambling claims.
